title: The Weakest Pet in the World

scenes.note: Aerial: the bright town, kids walking their pets
Every pet has a number floating above its head
Low angle: the number glowing over the lion
Zero. Literally zero. Extreme close-up of Nugget
The bully, Brax: low angle as he struts in
First day of school: kids arriving
The whole school filmed it (phones out, Brax laughing)
I picked him up, and he was shaking
The next morning: Nugget pushes a lost kitten out of the road
He carried my homework through the rain (leaf umbrella)
Sharing his last sunflower seed with a hungry pigeon
That's when I figured it out
Not by fighting (Nugget is tiny next to the tiger)
He got stronger by protecting people
So we trained. Every single day
Saving a little kid's balloon from a tree
Walking a lost puppy all the way home
Eighty-eight thousand! The crowd goes wild
Then the sky turned purple (everyone looks up)
A shadow monster rises over the city
Police dogs, fire dragons charge in…
The monster turned toward the school
Nobody… except Nugget (he leaps out of Max's hood)
He stood in front of the whole school
He looked back at me… and smiled
A giant golden hamster, glowing like the sun
One punch, and the monster exploded into stars
The whole city chanted his name
Every pet got its power back
…and for the first time ever, he said sorry
Nugget shrank back down, curled up in my hand, and fell asleep
But then I looked at Brax's tiger…
